pronunciation.approximation: Say "vohumanah" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "VohuManah".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "vohumanah" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "VohuManah" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: VohuManah
domains.subtitle: Good Mind
domains.lead: VohuManah is good mind, cattle. The name means "Good thought" and belongs to the zoroastrian tradition.

cards.name: Sacred Name
cards.desc: The restoration VohuManah returns the figure to scholarly recognition.

cards.name: Living Tradition
cards.desc: Honored in zoroastrian myth, cult, and cultural memory.

cards.name: Unicode Restoration
cards.desc: Preserved as a flagship temple despite the unregistrable plain-ASCII form.

symbols.name: Name
symbols.meaning: The restored form VohuManah, carrying scholarly and cultural weight.

mythology.lead: The stories of VohuManah place good mind, cattle at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: VohuManah appears in zoroastrian tradition as good mind, cattle. The name's meaning, "Good thought", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved VohuManah in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: VohuManah remains a touchstone for understanding zoroastrian religion, art, and identity.
